assets.prompt: Edit the provided Jeju landscape illustration into a human-centered banner for a Korean family healthcare coordination app. The original image is a style/color reference: preserve its sophisticated editorial gouache, subtle paper texture, warm ivory, sea glass green, teal, charcoal basalt and small tangerine-orange palette. Change the main story: caring for an elderly parent at a distance and connecting her local doctor to a remote specialist. Very wide 3:1 banner. Keep the left 30% quiet pale ivory and low detail for HTML heading overlay. Across the center and right, create two softly linked, clearly different spaces in one graceful composition: in the center, an older Korean mother, around 70, in a soft tangerine cardigan sits comfortably in a bright small Jeju clinic with a Korean local physician in a white coat beside her, attentive and speaking with her in person. A modest computer monitor on the doctor's desk clearly shows the portrait of a second specialist connected by video, no words on screen. On the far right, the mother's adult Korean daughter in her 30s is in her own city apartment at a distance, gently attentive while looking at her smartphone with a small appointment/checklist icon and her mother's small contact portrait, no lettering. Separate the daughter's space with a window or architectural framing, not a hospital desk. Show a restrained warm curved connection line between the family and doctors, expressing coordination and reassurance. Jeju sea, low basalt wall, a small tangerine branch and hazy mountain remain only subtle background cues through the clinic window, not the dominant subject. Clear focal hierarchy: mother and local doctor first, daughter second, remote specialist third. Warm natural light, calm adult human expressions, editorial adult illustration rather than cute mascot. Anatomically coherent hands, normal realistic devices. No patient suffering, no emergency equipment, no giant floating UI, no heart icons, no medical diagnosis text, absolutely no text or lettering anywhere, no logos, no watermarks. Maintain open breathing room. This is a new version, preserve the original separately.
assets.notes: 제주 어머니와 현지 의료진, 화면 속 도외 전문의, 떨어져 사는 자녀의 조율을 표현한 생성 일러스트. 실제 환자나 특정 의료기관의 사진·참여 증거가 아니다. v1 원본도 보존한다.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original editorial lifestyle photograph for a Korean family-care healthcare web workspace. Primary request: convey a daughter who lives far away helping her older mother in Jeju prepare for an outpatient visit, through an intimate credible everyday moment. Scene: a bright, modest modern Jeju home in soft morning daylight. A Korean mother in her late sixties, healthy ordinary appearance and natural gray-streaked short hair, wearing a muted sage cardigan over an ivory shirt, sits beside a window and quietly checks a smartphone held in her hands; a simple closed document folder and canvas day bag rest on the nearby table ready for her outing. Her expression is calm and reassured, not a posed advertising grin; she is looking at the phone, never at the camera. A small out-of-focus basalt garden wall and one citrus plant outside suggest Jeju subtly. Style: high-end candid editorial photography, natural skin and linen textures, believable hands, gentle depth of field, fresh and understated. Palette: warm ivory, deep forest green, soft sage, a tiny restrained tangerine accent. Composition: landscape 3:2, medium shot with the person on the right half and soft uncluttered light wall/window space to the left; frame safely so it works as a wide cropped welcome image as well as a compact crop. Constraints: this is a photo asset only, not a web page mockup. No readable phone screen, no medical records or personal data, no logos, no captions, no text, no watermark. No doctor, nurse, white coat, stethoscope, clinical equipment, giant landscape, sea panorama, distressed or helpless patient. The subject is fictional and must not resemble a known person.
assets.notes: 휴대전화로 가족과 연결되는 제주 어머니의 가상 일상 사진. 실제 환자·의료기관·파트너의 증거가 아니다. 원본 PNG를 보존하고 같은 크기의 WebP로 형식만 변환했다.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: quiet full-page background for a Korean caregiver healthcare web application, landscape composition.
Primary request: a calm, natural Jeju Island coastal background with black volcanic basalt, muted turquoise sea and a little soft coastal grass. No people.
Scene/backdrop: looking along a low Jeju basalt stone wall toward the sea on a softly overcast bright morning; distant low coastline and an open pale sky. Authentic volcanic rock texture, gentle sea, a few wind-shaped coastal plants, restrained colors.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal landscape. Broad quiet pale sky and sea across the upper and central two thirds; the low dark stone wall and grasses mainly along the bottom edge and far edges. The website will place opaque white chat and visit-summary panels on top, so avoid busy central details. Read unmistakably as Jeju without tourism landmarks or a poster aesthetic.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse daylight, peaceful, modest, photographic, no dramatic sunset, no heavy contrast.
Color palette: pale cool gray-green, muted sea turquoise, charcoal basalt, natural grass green.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no doctors, no human silhouettes, no buildings with text, no signage, no logos, no UI or cards, no watermark, no airplanes, no illustrated icons, no artificial gradients. This is a background photograph, not a hero banner or finished website.
assets.notes: 실제 특정 해안·기관·환자 위치의 증거가 아닌 독자 생성 배경. 인물·문구 없음. PNG 원본 보존, Chromium canvas로 같은 픽셀 크기에서 WebP 형식만 변환.
